name: DateTime Reset
description: Adds an optional reset button to datetime field widgets.
project_description:
This module provides a feature which allows admin user to display a "Reset"

button in a datetime field widgets by providing a toggle for it.

 Works with Date, Date/Time and Date range core fields.

 Some display tweaks are required for SmartDate fields ( related issue ).

 Usage 
 
 Enable the module 
 Go to Structure - Content type - (one of your content types with a date field) - Manage form display and make the date field display the reset button.
